subject: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and tabletop outcomes for Redwood integration
messages:
From: Jessica Sullivan <j.sullivan@meridianbank.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, ops@meridianbank.com
Cc: Jordan Miles <jordan@thirdparty-audit.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and tabletop outcomes for Redwood integration

Hi Dylan / Redwood team —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. As part of Meridian's platform-onboarding security review we need a short package documenting your recovery posture for the services we will rely on. Specifically would you please provide the following: 

- An RTO and RPO attestation for the customer-facing tokenization/session service and for model serving (per-region if available).
- Warm-start / cache-warmup traces from the most recent tabletop run showing observed time-to-ready for the request path.
- A 1–2 page executive tabletop summary (participants, timeline, lessons learned).
- A short runbook excerpt showing the restore steps we would witness during a live validation.
- A point of contact for a 30-minute witness session (we'd like to schedule week of Aug 16).

We have auditors who may ask follow-up questions (Jordan copied). If you can supply the artifacts by EOD Aug 12 that would keep our internal review on schedule.

Thanks —
Jessica
Security Review Manager
Meridian Bank

---
Note: Please include filenames for attachments rather than embedding large archives in email.

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Sullivan <j.sullivan@meridianbank.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Miles <jordan@thirdparty-audit.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and tabletop outcomes for Redwood integration

Jessica —

Appreciate the clear ask. See compressed set of artifacts listed below (we're attaching stubs and providing links to the Drive folder for large files). High-level callouts first, then the files.

High-level attestations (summary):
- Model-serving endpoints (hosted Redwood API): typical RTO target for a full-service warm restart path is 15 minutes (failover detection -> model variant warm -> routing). We document 95th percentile recovery within 12 minutes across our US regions in the attached matrix.
- Session/token service RTO: 3–5 minutes for failover to warm standby (primary state persisted to durable store with <5 min RPO).
- RPO: for persistent session and KV cache we target <=5 minutes; for in-memory KV we maintain snapshotting and prefix cache strategies to keep user-visible divergence within that window.

Files included (attachment stubs):
- redwood_rto_rpo_attestation.pdf — formal attestation signed by Ops Director (PDF stub).
- tabletop-executive-summary-20260728.pdf — two-page summary of the July 28 tabletop focused on multi-region failover and restore timings.
- warm-start-traces-20260728.zip — trace extracts (zipped logs and trace IDs) showing cache warming and readiness events.
- rpo_rto_matrix.csv — per-region numeric matrix (95/99 percentiles and test timestamps).
- runbook-restore-steps.md — sanitized runbook excerpt showing the recovery steps we would demonstrate.

Proposed witness session: Aug 17, 11:00am PT (30 minutes). We will do a short walkthrough, then a directed restore run with a single failover path and live measurement. Confirm if that works for your team.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_redwood-bcp
DocuSign attestation (placeholder): https://docusign.net/ATTACH/ABC123-redwood-attestation

If you need specific log lines or extra traces (e.g., KV cache warming per-shard), call out which shard IDs you want and Ben will pull them.

Regards,
Dylan Brooks
Head of Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: redwood_rto_rpo_attestation.pdf (PDF), tabletop-executive-summary-20260728.pdf (PDF), warm-start-traces-20260728.zip (ZIP), rpo_rto_matrix.csv (CSV), runbook-restore-steps.md (MD)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jessica Sullivan <j.sullivan@meridianbank.com>, Jordan Miles <jordan@thirdparty-audit.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and tabletop outcomes for Redwood integration

Dylan / team —

Couple of clarifications to include in the packet before we send to Meridian:
- Please ensure the rpo_rto_matrix.csv includes the distinction between observed recovery for "warm-standby" vs "cold-rebuild" paths. Meridian's reviewers tend to treat those differently; indicate which path each row references.
- Ben, can you paste the KV cache warm times (per-shard averages) into the runbook-restore-steps.md appendix so Meridian can see the observed step-by-step times (e.g., lookup ready -> prefix restore -> model warm complete).
- Let's redact any internal hostnames and replace with region tags (us-west-2, us-east-1).

Dylan — I'll queue the DocuSign attestation for signature once the PDF is finalized. Ben, flag me when you've uploaded the logs to the Drive link so I can verify integrity checks.

Thanks —
Hannah
Sr. Manager, Platform Ops
Redwood Inference

Uploading the requested artifacts now to the Drive folder and attaching the key CSV subset here: rpo_rto_matrix.csv (stub) and warm-start-traces-20260728.zip (stub).

Paste of the most relevant warm-start timings (sanitized):
- us-west-2 (warm-standby): detection -> routing switch: 18s; KV prefix restore (avg): 1m10s; model variant warm (first token latency within SLO): 7m55s; total observed ready: 9m43s.
- us-east-1 (warm-standby): detection -> routing switch: 22s; KV prefix restore (avg): 1m05s; model variant warm: 6m12s; total observed ready: 7m39s.
- cold-rebuild (single-region test): total observed ready: 42m (included for contrast).

Note: warm-start traces include trace IDs trace-usw2-20260728-34 and trace-use1-20260728-21 for audit. All logs are integrity-checked (SHA256 sums included in Drive manifest).

Ben Carter

Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the artifacts. We're going to review the Drive folder and circulate to the control owners; Jordan may have a couple of additional clarification questions around the trace IDs you provided.

Best,
Jessica Sullivan
